tools.name: list-player-rankings
tools.description: Get ranking snapshots for a player by providing their player ID. Each entry includes the ranking type (official/race/elo/earnings), position, points and diffs against the previous snapshot. For type `elo` the `points` field carries the Elo rating, so the series is the evolution of the rating over time. For type `earnings` the `points` field carries the prize money earned in the season, in the currency stated in `currency`. Without date filters returns the latest entry per type; with date filters returns the weekly historical series in that range. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.

player_id.description: The ID of the player to get rankings for.

after_date.description: Start date of the historical series (YYYY-MM-DD).

before_date.description: End date of the historical series (YYYY-MM-DD).

type.description: Filter by ranking type. Omit to return all of them.

tools.name: list-rankings
tools.description: Get the ranking list for a given week. Without `date` returns the latest snapshot; with `date` returns the snapshot in effect at that day. Each entry includes the ranking type, position, points, diffs against the previous snapshot (or against the snapshot in effect on `after_date` when given), `rated_matches` (rated matches in the 12 months before the snapshot), `gap_ranking` (position in the `gap_type` ranking in effect the same week) and `ranking_gap` (`gap_ranking` minus `ranking`). Types `official` and `race` are FIP points tables; type `elo` ranks players by Elo rating (carried in `points`) and only includes players with at least 5 rated matches in the last 12 months (a walkover or a bye never produces a rating); type `earnings` ranks players by prize money earned in the season (carried in `points`, currency in `currency`) and only includes players with earnings. Filter by ranking type, category (men/women), nationality (2-letter country code), age range and minimum rated matches. Sort by `ranking_diff`, `points_diff` or `ranking_gap`.

type.description: Ranking type. Defaults to `official` when omitted.

category.description: Filter by player category. Omit to return both.

nationality.description: 2-letter country code to filter the players by nationality (e.g. `ES`, `AR`).

date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) for which the ranking is requested. Defaults to the latest available snapshot.

after_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the period over which `ranking_diff` and `points_diff` are measured, against the snapshot in effect on that day. Defaults to the previous weekly snapshot.

min_age.description: Minimum age of the players, in years.

max_age.description: Maximum age of the players, in years.

min_matches.description: Minimum number of rated matches played in the 12 months before the snapshot.

gap_type.description: Ranking type `gap_ranking` and `ranking_gap` compare against. Defaults to `official`, or to `elo` when `type` is `official`.

sort_by.description: Field to sort the rankings by. `ranking_diff` and `points_diff` sort by the change since the previous snapshot or since `after_date`; `ranking_gap` by the difference against the `gap_type` ranking. Defaults to `ranking`.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results (e.g. 1 for the number one), or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Results are paginated: check `meta` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`) in the response and request further pages with this parameter until you have all the results you need.

tools.name: search-pairs
tools.description: List pairs of professional padel players that have played at least one match together. Returns the pair ID, players, status (`current` if it is the active pairing of both players, `former` otherwise), combined ranking points (only for current pairs) and the dates of their first and most recent match together.

id.description: Pair ID(s) to retrieve, comma-separated (e.g. `65-66,12-34`). Each pair ID is the two player IDs joined by a hyphen in ascending order.

category.description: Category of the pair. Either `men` or `women`.

status.description: Status of the pair: `current` if it is the active pairing of both players, `former` otherwise.

after_date.description: Date after which the pair has played a match in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Pairs without matches in the range are excluded.

before_date.description: Date before which the pair has played a match in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

sort_by.description: Name of the parameter to sort the pairs by, always descending. Defaults to `last_match_at` (date of their most recent match together). With `points`, pairs without points go last.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results, or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Results are paginated: check `meta` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`) in the response and request further pages with this parameter until you have all the results you need.

tools.name: search-players
tools.description: Search players by ID, name, nationality, category, birthplace or side. Returns the player ID, name, category, nationality, current ranking and points, Padel API Elo, height, side (drive/backhand), hand, birthplace, birthdate and age.

name.description: Name or surname of the player (or players) to search for. Matches any part of the full name, ignoring case and accents, so prefer the surname over a first name or nickname. To search for multiple players, separate names or surnames with commas.

nationality.description: 2-letter country code of the player (e.g. `ES`, `AR`). If the country is not clearly specified, omit this parameter.

category.description: Category of the player. Either `men` or `women`.

birthplace.description: Name of the birthplace of the player.

side.description: Side of the player, either `drive` or `backhand`.

sort_by.description: Name of the parameter to sort the players by.

order_by.description: Order of the sorting, either `asc` or `desc`.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results, or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Results are paginated: check `meta` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`) in the response and request further pages with this parameter until you have all the results you need.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results, or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

location.description: City or location where the tournament is held.

country.description: 2-letter country code of the tournament location (e.g. `ES`, `FR`).

level.description: Filter by tournament level(s), comma-separated. Premier Padel: major, p1, p2, finals. FIP tour: fip_platinum, fip_gold, fip_silver, fip_other. tools.name: show-match-live
tools.description: Get point-by-point details for a specific match ID. Returns the play-by-play score data for each set and game, available both during live matches and after they have finished. Only available for matches of these tournament levels: finals, fip_other, fip_platinum, major, p1, p2.

match_id.description: ID of the match to retrieve live score for

tools.name: show-match-stats
tools.description: Get detailed match statistics for a specific match ID. Returns per-team stats for the match and for each set: points won, break points converted, longest streak, aces, double faults, and points won on first/second serve and return. Only available for matches of these tournament levels: finals, fip_other, fip_platinum, major, p1, p2.

match_id.description: ID of the match to retrieve stats for

tools.name: show-pair-stats
tools.description: Get statistics for a pair of players by providing their player IDs. Returns matches played and won, win percentage, sets and games won/lost, titles, finals, semifinals and best round. To get the player IDs, use the "search-players" tool.

player_1_id.description: The ID of the first player in the pair.

player_2_id.description: The ID of the second player in the pair.

after_date.description: Calculate stats from matches played after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

before_date.description: Calculate stats from matches played before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

level.description: Filter by tournament level(s), comma-separated. Premier Padel: major, p1, p2, finals. FIP tour: fip_platinum, fip_gold, fip_silver, fip_other. World Padel Tour (historical): wpt_master, wpt_1000, wpt_500, wpt_final. Padel Pro Tour (historical): ppt_master, ppt_final, ppt_international, ppt_promotional, ppt_other.

round.description: Filter stats by match round (1 = Final, 2 = Semifinal, 4 = Quarterfinal, 8 = Round of 16, 16 = Round of 32, 32 = Round of 64).

tools.name: show-pair-synergy
tools.description: Get the synergy of a pair of players by providing their player IDs: results together against what their Elo ratings predicted. Returns expected and actual win rate, the delta between them and matches played together, and the same values by quarter with their trend (rising, stable or declining). To get the player IDs, use the "search-players" tool.

player_1_id.description: The ID of the first player in the pair.

player_2_id.description: The ID of the second player in the pair.

after_date.description: Measure the synergy from matches played after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

before_date.description: Measure the synergy from matches played before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

level.description: Filter by tournament level(s), comma-separated. Premier Padel: major, p1, p2, finals. FIP tour: fip_platinum, fip_gold, fip_silver, fip_other. World Padel Tour (historical): wpt_master, wpt_1000, wpt_500, wpt_final. Padel Pro Tour (historical): ppt_master, ppt_final, ppt_international, ppt_promotional, ppt_other.

round.description: Filter by match round (1 = Final, 2 = Semifinal, 4 = Quarterfinal, 8 = Round of 16, 16 = Round of 32, 32 = Round of 64).

tools.name: show-player-audience
tools.description: Get the popularity of a player among padel fans by providing their player ID (Padel Fan Index), measured over a window (last 12 months by default). Returns fan_share (percentage of fan interest that went to the player), popularity_rank (position by fan_share), popularity_index (fan interest against the interest expected for the player's level, 1.0 = as expected, 2.0 = twice), fan_share by month and its trend (rising, stable or declining). Every value is relative to the rest of the circuit, never an absolute fan count. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.

player_id.description: The ID of the player to get the audience for.

after_date.description: Start of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 12 months before before_date.

before_date.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

tools.name: show-player-form
tools.description: Get the form of a player by providing their player ID: results against what their Elo rating predicted. Returns expected and actual win rate, the delta between them and matches played over the window (last 180 days by default), the same values by month with their trend (rising, stable or declining), rolling windows of the last 7, 30 and 90 days, the same window one year earlier, the current win or loss streak, and the record in third sets and tiebreaks. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.

player_id.description: The ID of the player to get the form for.

after_date.description: Start of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 180 days before before_date.

before_date.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

level.description: Filter by tournament level(s), comma-separated. Premier Padel: major, p1, p2, finals. FIP tour: fip_platinum, fip_gold, fip_silver, fip_other. World Padel Tour (historical): wpt_master, wpt_1000, wpt_500, wpt_final. Padel Pro Tour (historical): ppt_master, ppt_final, ppt_international, ppt_promotional, ppt_other.

round.description: Filter by match round (1 = Final, 2 = Semifinal, 4 = Quarterfinal, 8 = Round of 16, 16 = Round of 32, 32 = Round of 64).

player_id.description: The ID of the player to get statistics for.

World Padel Tour (historical): wpt_master, wpt_1000, wpt_500, wpt_final. Padel Pro Tour (historical): ppt_master, ppt_final, ppt_international, ppt_promotional, ppt_other.

round.description: Filter stats by match round (1 = Final, 2 = Semifinal, 4 = Quarterfinal, 8 = Round of 16, 16 = Round of 32, 32 = Round of 64).

tools.name: simulate-match
tools.description: Simulate a match between players from two teams. Provide player IDs for both teams (use the "search-players" tool to get them). Returns: name (of the match), probability (win probability of team_1 and team_2 as a percentage), favorite ("team_1" or "team_2", null if evenly rated), elo_diff (Padel API Elo gap between the teams), played_at (day the simulation is rated for) and players (the full player details per team).

team_1.description: List of player IDs for team 1

team_2.description: List of player IDs for team 2

played_at.description: Day the match would be played, as YYYY-MM-DD. Players are rated with the Elo they had entering that day, so you can replay a past match-up with the ratings of the time. Optional, defaults to today.
